description: Change of use from Bank (Use Class A2) to Nursery (Use Class D1) for children 0 to 5 years old
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Proposed Plan (Cycle & Buggy Stores)  Received:  18 July 2019; Unreferenced Location Plan, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06  Received:  03 June 2019; Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  11 April 2019; Unreferenced Existing Plan (Flat)  Received:  09 April 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the completion of the approved conversion from A2 to D1 use, full details (including manufacturer's specifications and means of enclosure) of the cycle parking provision for the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout, and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 

In addition, full details (including manufacturer's specifications and means of enclosure) of a store to accommodate children's bicycles/ scooters (20) and pushchairs/ buggies (15-20) shall also be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the completion of the approved conversion from A2 to D1 use, details of the arrangements for the storing of waste and recycled materials for the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, these arrangements shall be implemented in accordance with the agreed details.

Condition : 7 - The premises shall be used for a nursery and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
